provenance.derivation: previous post-quarantine census plus final ten exact deletions; final SQLite not queried

final_dataset.database_read_method_for_delta: file fingerprint only; no SQLite queries

definitions.strict120: mapped contract at candidate date has all last 120 explicit source trading dates with true observed opening OI and other legacy108 input fields; not a training sample
definitions.field_complete: one mapped date has all legacy108 required source fields; not a training sample
definitions.close_only_exclusive: observed clean row AND NOT field_complete; does not mean OHLC/volume/closeOI is absent
definitions.monthly_status: all existing 18 products at the last source-calendar date in each month, including explicit missing mappings
definitions.date_ranges: first/last available date only; gaps may exist between endpoints; no continuous-range claim
definitions.labels: 60-date future labels, maturity, PIT and financial outcomes not computed
